component.name: SuperTuxKart Touch
component.summary: Touch-first SuperTuxKart for Linux tablets and phones

description.p: SuperTuxKart Touch is a tablet-first build of SuperTuxKart with a glass virtual stick, drift / item / nitro buttons, touch settings, and an in-game screen keyboard. Defaults favour thermal headroom on fanless devices (30 FPS, reduced RTTs, lights/shadows off).
The Flatpak ships the touch engine and UI. Race assets (tracks and karts) are reused from a system Flathub SuperTuxKart install when available, keeping this package slim.
